In recognition of successful completion of the comprehensive 
Teacher of English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL) 
certification program, demonstrating mastery of language teaching methodology, classroom management, and instructional design.

Language Teaching Methodology: 60 Hours
Classroom Management Techniques: 20 Hours
Lesson Planning and Curriculum Design: 30 Hours
Teaching Practicum: 40 Hours
Assessment and Evaluation: 10 Hours
This certificate qualifies the holder to teach English as a foreign language in international educational contexts.
